findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: coin_check, get_referral_info · Public sink: route_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: coin_check, get_referral_info · Public sink: route_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
